Hi Supergoop! team,

We are a small Instagram content studio eager to collaborate with you on a collaborative Instagram post. We’d like to propose a post that builds on the fact that Supergoop! drives 40,000 product samples and 10 festival stops with AGENC Supergoop! partnered with AGENC to launch their “Every [P3]. You’ve demonstrated a commitment to personalized shopper journeys through Solution Supergoop! and Envive AI, and we believe a shared Instagram post would be a fantastic way to showcase these advancements. This post would feature a visually compelling image or short video showcasing the personalized experience of choosing Supergoop! based on individual shopper data, highlighting the power of AI-driven recommendations. We envision working together to create a cohesive and engaging visual experience.

The BrandPilot team
